title: Fleet enrollment success responses
description: Success JSON body including the request_id response wrapper. Claim returns HTTP 202; status and confirm return HTTP 200. Select the exact route profile. Existing requests, HMAC and consent requirements are unchanged. Error bodies are outside this schema.

pendingExpiry.description: Authoritative enrollment pending deadline, copied from the committed DB row as Unix epoch milliseconds. Applies only while claimed or admin_approved. After active it is historical metadata: never use this deadline to expire continuing monitoring or infer renewed consent. No client-calculated 24-hour substitute.

claim.description: POST /v2/enrollments/claim, including same-ID replay. Identity and pending deadline come from the current DB row, including after an ACK is lost.

tenant_name.description: Current per-request installation display label, not identity. Nonempty <=512 Unicode code points, no C0 or DEL controls. Invalid stored metadata receives a fixed 503 response and cannot authorize confirmation.

alias.description: Enrollment alias copied when registration was issued; no pending rename API is exposed. Display changes never authorize monitoring; stable claim/device/key/audience/consent fields and current DB state are authoritative.

status.description: POST /v2/enrollments/status. A past pending_expires_at remains valid historical metadata when state is active; this timestamp does not grant monitoring permission.

tenant_name.description: Current per-request installation display label, not identity. Nonempty <=512 Unicode code points, no C0 or DEL controls. Invalid stored metadata receives a fixed 503 response and cannot authorize confirmation.

confirm.description: POST /v2/enrollments/confirm, including reconciliation after an ACK is lost. Activation does not renew or replace the original pending deadline.

$comment: The root oneOf is a shape summary, not route authorization. Select $defs.claim, $defs.status or $defs.confirm from the exact authenticated route. In particular, a status-shaped claimed/admin_approved response must never be accepted as a confirm result; confirm requires state=active.
